<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>2026 Wakirike Be-Se Bible Study Conference - Registration</title>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Playfair+Display:wght@700;900&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  *, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

  body {
    min-height: 100vh;
    background: linear-gradient(170deg, #1a0800 0%, #2d1206 35%, #1a0800 70%, #0d0400 100%);
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    color: #FFF8E7;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 24px 16px 60px;
  }

  .form-wrapper {
    width: 100%;
    max-width: 560px;
  }

  .header {
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .header::after {
    content: '';
    display: block;
    width: 120px;
    height: 2px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #DFAD4C, transparent);
    margin: 20px auto 0;
  }

  .diocese-logo {
    width: 100px;
    height: auto;
    margin: 0 auto 16px;
    display: block;
    border-radius: 6px;
    filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 12px rgba(223,173,76,0.3));
  }

  .org-label {
    font-size: 11px;
    letter-spacing: 3px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    color: #DFAD4C;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
  }

  .event-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-weight: 900;
    font-size: clamp(18px, 4.5vw, 22px);
    line-height: 1.3;
    color: #FFF8E7;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
  }

  .theme-badge {
    display: inline-block;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #DFAD4C, #C4872A);
    color: #1a0800;
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: clamp(15px, 3.5vw, 18px);
    padding: 6px 20px;
    border-radius: 4px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .scripture-ref {
    font-size: 13px;
    color: rgba(223, 173, 76, 0.7);
    font-style: italic;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .event-meta {
    font-size: 12.5px;
    color: rgba(255,248,231,0.6);
    line-height: 1.6;
  }

  .event-meta strong {
    color: #DFAD4C;
  }

  .form-card {
    background: linear-gradient(165deg, rgba(45,18,6,0.95) 0%, rgba(26,8,0,0.98) 100%);
    border: 1px solid rgba(223,173,76,0.2);
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 32px 28px 36px;
    box-shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  }

  .form-heading {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 20px;
    color: #DFAD4C;
    text-align: center;
    margin-bottom: 28px;
  }

  .field-group {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .field-group label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,248,231,0.85);
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  }

  .field-group label .required {
    color: #DFAD4C;
    margin-left: 2px;
  }

  .field-group input[type="text"],
  .field-group input[type="email"],
  .field-group input[type="tel"] {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 12px 14px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06);
    border: 1px solid rgba(223,173,76,0.25);
    border-radius: 6px;
    color: #FFF8E7;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 14.5px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s, background 0.2s;
    outline: none;
  }

  .field-group input:focus {
    border-color: #DFAD4C;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.1);
  }

  .field-group input::placeholder {
    color: rgba(255,248,231,0.3);
  }

  .couple-section {
    margin-bottom: 20px;
  }

  .couple-section > label {
    display: block;
    font-size: 13px;
    font-weight: 600;
    color: rgba(255,248,231,0.85);
    margin-bottom: 10px;
    letter-spacing: 0.3px;
  }

  .radio-row {
    display: flex;
    gap: 12px;
  }

  .radio-option {
    flex: 1;
    position: relative;
  }

  .radio-option input[type="radio"] {
    position: absolute;
    opacity: 0;
    width: 0;
    height: 0;
  }

  .radio-option .radio-label {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 8px;
    padding: 10px 16px;
    background: rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    border: 1px solid rgba(223,173,76,0.2);
    border-radius: 6px;
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 500;
    color: rgba(255,248,231,0.7);
    transition: all 0.2s;
  }

  .radio-option input[type="radio"]:checked + .radio-label {
    background: rgba(223,173,76,0.15);
    border-color: #DFAD4C;
    color: #DFAD4C;
  }

  .radio-option .radio-label:hover {
    background: rgba(223,173,76,0.08);
  }

  .radio-dot {
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    border: 2px solid rgba(223,173,76,0.4);
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }

  .radio-option input[type="radio"]:checked + .radio-label .radio-dot {
    border-color: #DFAD4C;
  }

  .radio-option input[type="radio"]:checked + .radio-label .radio-dot::after {
    content: '';
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    left: 50%;
    transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
    width: 7px;
    height: 7px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: #DFAD4C;
  }

  .spouse-section {
    overflow: hidden;
    max-height: 0;
    opacity: 0;
    transition: max-height 0.4s ease, opacity 0.3s ease, margin 0.3s ease;
    margin-top: 0;
  }

  .spouse-section.visible {
    max-height: 220px;
    opacity: 1;
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .spouse-inner {
    border-left: 2px solid rgba(223,173,76,0.3);
    padding-left: 20px;
    padding-top: 4px;
  }

  .spouse-inner .field-group:last-child {
    margin-bottom: 0;
  }

  .form-divider {
    width: 100%;
    height: 1px;
    background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(223,173,76,0.25), transparent);
    margin: 24px 0;
  }

  .submit-btn {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 14px 24px;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #DFAD4C, #C4872A);
    border: none;
    border-radius: 6px;
    color: #1a0800;
    font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-weight: 700;
    letter-spacing: 1px;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: transform 0.15s, box-shadow 0.2s;
  }

  .submit-btn:hover {
    transform: translateY(-1px);
    box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(223,173,76,0.3);
  }

  .submit-btn:active {
    transform: translateY(0);
  }

  .form-footer {
    text-align: center;
    margin-top: 20px;
    font-size: 11.5px;
    color: rgba(255,248,231,0.35);
    line-height: 1.5;
  }

  .form-footer .hashtags {
    color: rgba(223,173,76,0.5);
    margin-top: 4px;
  }

  .success-overlay {
    display: none;
    text-align: center;
    padding: 48px 20px;
  }

  .success-overlay.show {
    display: block;
  }

  .success-icon {
    width: 64px;
    height: 64px;
    border-radius: 50%;
    background: linear-gradient(135deg, #DFAD4C, #C4872A);
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: 0 auto 20px;
  }

  .success-icon svg {
    width: 32px;
    height: 32px;
    stroke: #1a0800;
    fill: none;
    stroke-width: 3;
    stroke-linecap: round;
    stroke-linejoin: round;
  }

  .success-title {
    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 22px;
    color: #DFAD4C;
    margin-bottom: 10px;
  }

  .success-msg {
    font-size: 14px;
    color: rgba(255,248,231,0.7);
    line-height: 1.6;
    max-width: 360px;
    margin: 0 auto;
  }

  .form-inner.hidden {
    display: none;
  }

  @media (max-width: 420px) {
    .form-card { padding: 24px 18px 28px; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="form-wrapper">

  <div class="header">
    <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Diocese of Okrika" class="diocese-logo">
    <div class="org-label">Church of Nigeria (Anglican Communion) &#8212; Diocese of Okrika</div>
    <div class="event-title">2026 Wakirike Be-Se Bible Study<br>Conference &amp; Mega Crusade</div>
    <div class="theme-badge">&#8220;Indwelled by the Word of God&#8221;</div>
    <div class="scripture-ref">Colossians 3:16</div>
    <div class="event-meta">
      <strong>22nd &#8211; 24th October, 2026</strong><br>
      Okrika Grammar School (OGS), Okrika
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="form-card">
    <div class="form-heading">Registration Form</div>

    <div class="form-inner" id="formInner">

      <div class="field-group">
        <label>Full Name <span class="required">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="fullName" placeholder="Enter your full name" required>
      </div>

      <div class="field-group">
        <label>Church / Ministry <span class="required">*</span></label>
        <input type="text" id="church" placeholder="e.g. St. Peter&#39;s Anglican Church, Okrika">
      </div>

      <div class="field-group">
        <label>Email Address <span class="required">*</span></label>
        <input type="email" id="email" placeholder="you@example.com">
      </div>

      <div class="field-group">
        <label>Telephone Number <span class="required">*</span></label>
        <input type="tel" id="phone" placeholder="e.g. 08012345678">
      </div>

      <div class="form-divider"></div>

      <div class="couple-section">
        <label>Coming as a couple? <span class="required">*</span></label>
        <div class="radio-row">
          <div class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="couple" id="coupleYes" value="yes">
            <label for="coupleYes" class="radio-label">
              <span class="radio-dot"></span> Yes
            </label>
          </div>
          <div class="radio-option">
            <input type="radio" name="couple" id="coupleNo" value="no" checked>
            <label for="coupleNo" class="radio-label">
              <span class="radio-dot"></span> No
            </label>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="spouse-section" id="spouseSection">
        <div class="spouse-inner">
          <div class="field-group">
            <label>Name of Spouse</label>
            <input type="text" id="spouseName" placeholder="Spouse&#39;s full name">
          </div>
          <div class="field-group">
            <label>Phone No. of Spouse</label>
            <input type="tel" id="spousePhone" placeholder="Spouse&#39;s phone number">
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="form-divider"></div>

      <button type="button" class="submit-btn" id="submitBtn">Register Now</button>
    </div>

    <div class="success-overlay" id="successOverlay">
      <div class="success-icon">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><polyline points="20 6 9 17 4 12"></polyline></svg>
      </div>
      <div class="success-title">Registration Complete</div>
      <div class="success-msg">
        Thank you for registering for the 2026 Wakirike Be-Se Bible Study Conference &amp; Mega Crusade. We look forward to seeing you!
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <div class="form-footer">
    Jesus is Lord Forever<br>
    <span class="hashtags">#DOKMCC2026 #DioceseOfOkrika</span>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
  const coupleYes = document.getElementById('coupleYes');
  const coupleNo = document.getElementById('coupleNo');
  const spouseSection = document.getElementById('spouseSection');

  coupleYes.addEventListener('change', () => {
    spouseSection.classList.add('visible');
  });

  coupleNo.addEventListener('change', () => {
    spouseSection.classList.remove('visible');
  });

  document.getElementById('submitBtn').addEventListener('click', () => {
    const name = document.getElementById('fullName').value.trim();
    const church = document.getElementById('church').value.trim();
    const email = document.getElementById('email').value.trim();
    const phone = document.getElementById('phone').value.trim();

    if (!name || !church || !email || !phone) {
      ['fullName', 'church', 'email', 'phone'].forEach(id => {
        const el = document.getElementById(id);
        if (!el.value.trim()) {
          el.style.borderColor = '#c0392b';
          el.addEventListener('input', function handler() {
            el.style.borderColor = '';
            el.removeEventListener('input', handler);
          });
        }
      });
      return;
    }

    document.getElementById('formInner').classList.add('hidden');
    document.getElementById('successOverlay').classList.add('show');
  });
</script>

</body>
</html>
